name: 亚历克斯·萨默维尔
name_full: 亚历克斯·萨默维尔 Alex Somerville

last_movies.title: 星际迷航：星际舰队学院 第一季

introduction: Alex Somerville is a Toronto-based voice actor and on-screen performer — a dual Canadian and US citizen with a versatile range spanning calm, authoritative commercial reads through to gruff soldiers and immersive creature vocals. With training from some of the industry's leading coaches across commercial, character, and performance disciplines, Alex brings depth, nuance, and commitment to every session.Beyond the booth, Alex is an experienced on-screen performer with credits including See, Titans, Adults, and Star Trek: Starfleet Academy, alongside motion capture work spanning combat efforts, creature performance, and full-body character embodiment.
